description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Civil Procedure Code (Under Section 192)
categorisation: The gazette content is a notification by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, issued under the authority of the Civil Procedure Code, that formally sets the new "Legal Rate of Interest." It is a regulatory determination that establishes a binding rate for legal proceedings. This fits the definition of a **Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5)**, as it involves the exercise of statutory power to amend or set a regulatory parameter (the interest rate) that has legal effect. The mention of a named official (Dr. P. Nandalal Weerasinghe) is incidental to the announcement of the regulatory change and does not constitute a government personnel appointment or a description of ministerial portfolios, so the government-related classifications (1-3) do not apply.
